events.name: Dear Jacksonville: A Love Letter - 21 Years in the Making
events.info: Dear Jacksonville: A Love Letter, 21 Years in the Making For 21 years, News4JAX morning show anchor Melanie Lawson has shared Jacksonville?s stories. Along the way, the city shaped her own. On her 50th birthday, Melanie takes the stage at the Ritz Theatre and Museum to tell that story through laughter, music, dance and local talent. From the 29-year-old who arrived for a job to the woman who found a home, a family and a purpose here, Dear Jacksonville is a celebration of the people and moments that made her. Join Melanie for a birthday celebration honoring the city she loves. A portion of the event?s proceeds will benefit Empowerment Resources, Inc. VIP tickets include access to a pre-show reception and VIP seating. October 29, 2026 | Doors open at 6 p.m. | Show begins at 7 p.m.

events.info: The "COME WORSHIP! Tour" is an invitation from CeCe Winans to bring together audiences of every generation, ethnicity, and denomination while worshipping Jesus as a unified congregation. Winans is excited to bring along some of the biggest worship leaders for an evening designed to be unlike anything audiences have experienced before. Joined by special guest Charity Gayle, whose anthems including "Thank You Jesus for the Blood" and "I Speak Jesus" have become modern worship staples, the tour creates a sacred space marked by faith, expectancy, and unity. Rounding out the night will be Red Worship and Terrian, two of the newest and most powerful voices in worship music. Reserved Doors - 6:00 PM Show - 7:00 PM

events.name: JAX SYMPHONY: MAHLER'S NINTH
events.info: Mahler's Ninth Journey through Symphony No. 9, a deeply personal work that spans vast emotional landscapes while revealing moments of profound vulnerability. Fragile stillness gives way to surges of intensity, irony and yearning as Gustav Mahler twists beauty and tension into constantly shifting forms. Immersive, expansive and deeply rewarding, this is Mahler at his most searching and human.
